arxiv-2104-01327.title: Zeus: Locality-aware Distributed Transactions Conference: Sixteenth European Conference on Computer Systems; April 26–29, 2021; Online, United Kingdom Sixteenth European Conference on Computer Systems (EuroSys ’21), April 26–29, 2021, Online, United Kingdom Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3447786.3456234
arxiv-2104-01327.creator: Antonios Katsarakis † ∗ {}^{\dagger^{*}} , Yijun Ma ‡ , Zhaowei Tan § ∗ {}^{\mathsection^{*}} , Andrew Bainbridge, Matthew Balkwill, Aleksandar Dragojevic, Boris Grot † , Bozidar Radunovic, Yongguang Zhang
arxiv-2104-01327.description: Abstract . State-of-the-art distributed in-memory datastores (FaRM, FaSST, DrTM) provide strongly-consistent distributed transactions with high performance and availability. Transactions in those systems are fully general; they can atomically manipulate any set of objects in the store, regardless of their location. To achieve this, these systems use complex distributed transactional protocols. Meanwhile, many workloads have a high degree of locality.

arxiv-2112-00992.title: Hierarchical Forecasting of Dengue Incidence in Sri Lanka Thanks: Corresponding author
arxiv-2112-00992.creator: L. S. Madushani
arxiv-2112-00992.description: Abstract The recurrent thread of dengue incidence in Sri Lanka is still abundant and it creates a huge burden to the country. Hence, the National Dengue Control Unit of Sri Lanka propose a national action plan to prevent and control the dengue incidence.

arxiv-2206-05379.title: A Benchmark for Compositional Visual Reasoning
arxiv-2206-05379.creator: Aimen Zerroug, Mohit Vaishnav, Julien Colin, Sebastian Musslick, Thomas Serre
arxiv-2206-05379.description: Abstract A fundamental component of human vision is our ability to parse complex visual scenes and judge the relations between their constituent objects. AI benchmarks for visual reasoning have driven rapid progress in recent years with state-of-the-art systems now reaching human accuracy on some of these benchmarks.

arxiv-2208-09773.title: Skew Howe duality for Types 𝐁𝐃 \mathbf{BD} via q q -Clifford algebras
arxiv-2208-09773.creator: Willie Aboumrad
arxiv-2208-09773.description: Abstract . We extend a quantized skew Howe duality result for Type 𝐀 \mathbf{A} algebras to orthogonal types via a seesaw. We develop an operator commutant version of the First Fundamental Theorem of invariant theory for U q ​ ( 𝔰 ​ 𝔬 n ) U_{q}(\mathfrak{so}_{n}) using a double centralizer property inside a quantized Clifford algebra.

arxiv-2302-05099.title: Tasks Decomposition Approaches in Crowdsourcing Software Development
arxiv-2302-05099.creator: Abdullah Khanfor
arxiv-2302-05099.description: Abstract A main characteristic of crowdsourcing software development (CSD) is the complexity of tasks and skills required by workers to achieve successful software crowdsourcing. The tasks proposed to the crowd in CSD are checked to ensure they are manageable and achievable. In general, individual tasks come from general goal-oriented projects.

arxiv-2303-06420.title: Design and Evaluation of a Rack-Scale Disaggregated Memory Architecture For Data Centers
arxiv-2303-06420.creator: Amit Puri, John Jose, Tamarapalli Venkatesh
arxiv-2303-06420.description: Abstract Memory disaggregation is being considered as a strong alternative to traditional architecture to deal with the memory under-utilization in data centers. Disaggregated memory can adapt to dynamically changing memory requirements for the data center applications like data analytics, big data, etc., that require in-memory processing.

arxiv-2307-01256.title: Can cuspy dark matter dominated halos hold cored stellar mass distributions? numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 )
arxiv-2307-01256.creator: Jorge Sánchez Almeida, Angel R. Plastino, Ignacio Trujillo
arxiv-2307-01256.description: Abstract According to the current concordance cosmological model, the dark matter (DM) particles are collision-less and produce self-gravitating structures with a central cusp which, generally, is not observed. The observed density tends to a central plateau or core, explained within the cosmological model through the gravitational feedback of baryons on DM.

arxiv-2308-04267.title: The Vulnerable Nature of Decentralized Governance in DeFi
arxiv-2308-04267.creator: Maya Dotan, Aviv Yaish, Hsin-Chu Yin, Eytan Tsytkin, Aviv Zohar
arxiv-2308-04267.description: Abstract Decentralized Finance (DeFi) platforms are often governed by Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) which are implemented via governance protocols. Governance tokens are distributed to users of the platform, granting them voting rights in the platform’s governance protocol. Many DeFi platforms have already been subject to attacks resulting in the loss of millions of dollars in user funds.

arxiv-2407-06917.title: Who is better at math, Jenny or Jingzhen? Uncovering Stereotypes in Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-06917.creator: Zara Siddique, Liam D. Turner, Luis Espinosa-Anke
arxiv-2407-06917.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zara Siddique, Liam D. Turner, Luis Espinosa-Anke. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to propagate and amplify harmful stereotypes, particularly those that disproportionately affect marginalised communities. To understand the effect of these stereotypes more comprehensively, we introduce GlobalBias, a dataset of 876k sentences incorporating 40 distinct gender-by-ethnicity groups alongside descriptors typically used in bias literature, which enables us to study a broad set of stereotypes from around the world.

arxiv-2409-05943.title: NuSTAR Observation of the TeV-Detected Radio Galaxy 3C 264: Core Emission and the Hot Accretion Flow Contribution
arxiv-2409-05943.creator: Ka-Wah Wong, Colin M. Steiner, Allison M. Blum, Dacheng Lin, Rodrigo Nemmen, Jimmy A. Irwin, Daniel R. Wik
arxiv-2409-05943.description: Abstract 3C 264 is one of the few FRI radio galaxies with detected TeV emission. It is a low-luminosity AGN (LLAGN) and is generally associated with a radiatively inefficient accretion flow (RIAF). Earlier multiwavelength studies suggest that the X-ray emission originates from a jet. However, the possibility that the RIAF can significantly contribute to the X-rays cannot be ruled out.

arxiv-2502-09000.title: Residual Transformer Fusion Network for Salt and Pepper Image Denoising
arxiv-2502-09000.creator: Bintang Pradana Erlangga Putra, Heri Prasetyo, Esti Suryani
arxiv-2502-09000.description: Abstract Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has been widely used in unstructured datasets, one of which is image denoising. Image denoising is a noisy image reconstruction process that aims to reduce additional noise that occurs from the noisy image with various strategies. Image denoising has a problem, namely that some image denoising methods require some prior knowledge of information about noise.

plos-pone-0009461.title: Sensitivity of the Goldfish Motion Detection System Revealed by Incoherent Random Dot Stimuli: Comparison of Behavioural and Neuronal Data
plos-pone-0009461.creator: Olivia Andrea Masseck, Sascha Förster, Klaus-Peter Hoffmann
plos-pone-0009461.description: PLOS ONE research article. Global motion detection is one of the most important abilities in the animal kingdom to navigate through a 3-dimensional environment. In the visual system of teleost fish direction-selective neurons in the pretectal area (APT) are most important for global motion detection. As in

pmc-10491819.title: Metastatic pulmonary calcification on bone scintigraphy of a patient with lupus nephritis and end-stage renal disease
pmc-10491819.creator: Nina H. Cheng, Yi Li, Gang Cheng
pmc-10491819.description: A 65-year-old male complaining of low back pain was noted to have diffuse, homogenous bilateral lung uptake on Tc-99m methylene diphosphate (Tc99m-MDP) bone scintigraphy. The patient had no prior history of pulmonary disease with no apparent respiratory symptoms at time of imaging, but did endorse a long history of lupus nephritis and end-stage renal disease on hemodialysis.

pmc-10674975.title: Collaborative Use of Sensor Networks and Cyberinfrastructure to Understand Complex Ecosystem Interactions in a Tropical Rainforest: Challenges and Lessons Learned
pmc-10674975.creator: Philip W Rundel, Thomas C Harmon, Angel S Fernandez-Bou, Michael F Allen, Yoshio Inoue
pmc-10674975.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Collaborations between ecosystem ecologists and engineers have led to impressive progress in developing complex models of biogeochemical fluxes in response to global climate change. Ecology and engineering iteratively inform and transform each other in these efforts. Nested data streams from local sources, adjacent networks, and remote sensing sources together magnify the capacity of ecosystem ecologists to observe systems in near real-time and address questions at temporal and spatial scales that were previously unobtainable.

pmc-12405463.title: A dual-stream deep learning framework for skin cancer classification using histopathological-inherited and vision-based feature extraction
pmc-12405463.creator: Saleh Ateeq Almutairi
pmc-12405463.description: Skin cancer, particularly melanoma, remains one of the most life-threatening forms of cancer worldwide, with early detection being critical for improving patient outcomes. Traditional diagnostic methods, such as dermoscopy and histopathology, are often limited by subjectivity, interobserver variability, and resource constraints.

pmc-12607427.title: Prognostic and Predictive Significance of B7-H3 and CD155 Expression in Gastric Cancer Patients
pmc-12607427.creator: Ozlem Dalda, Zehra Bozdag, Sami Akbulut, Hasan Gokce, Yasin Dalda, Ayse Nur Akatli, Mustafa Huz
pmc-12607427.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: This study aimed to characterize the expression patterns of B7 homolog 3 (B7-H3) and cluster of differentiation 155 (CD155), two immune-related transmembrane glycoproteins, in resectable gastric adenocarcinoma and to elucidate their clinicopathological, prognostic, and molecular implications. Methods: The study included 112 patients who underwent gastrectomy for gastric adenocarcinoma between 2020 and 2025, along with 30 samples of normal gastric tissue obtained from sleeve gastrectomy specimens. Histological subtype, grade of differentiation, TNM stage, and invasion parameters were re-evaluated.

pmc-12985208.title: Machine-Learning-Derived, Mechanistically Informed Transcriptomic Signature to Diagnose Active Tuberculosis and Guide Host-Directed Therapy
pmc-12985208.creator: Asif Hassan Syed, Nashwan Alromema, Hatem A. Almazarqi, Jasrah Irfan, Shakeel Ahmad, Altyeb A. Taha, Alhuseen Omar Alsayed
pmc-12985208.description: Background/Objectives: An important diagnostic problem is to differentiate between active tuberculosis (TB) and latent TB infection (LTBI). Furthermore, the current biomarkers also offer minimal insight into disease pathogenesis to direct treatment. This triggered us to design a two-mode biomarker signature based on the multicohort analysis using a transcriptomic and stringent machine learning pipeline.

pmc-13240553.title: Wastewater‐Based Assessment of Antimicrobial Resistance and Bacterial Communities in Urban and Rural Areas in the Province of Trento (Italy)
pmc-13240553.creator: Maya Petricciuolo, Agnese Carnevali, Alessia Torboli, Mattia Postinghel, Alessia Guasticchi, Paola Foladori, Maria Cadonna, Ermanno Federici
pmc-13240553.description: Wastewater‐based epidemiology (WBE) can supplement clinical surveillance for assessing the spread of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) across the population. We have analyzed sewage samples from seven wastewater treatment plants in the Province of Trento (Italy) using both culture‐based and metagenomic DNA methods to investigate the prevalence of antimicrobial‐resistant bacteria (ARBs) and resistance genes in urban and rural areas.

pmc-13535116.title: Multiple Organ‐Dysfunction Secondary to Multiple Bee Sting: A Case Report From Tanzania
pmc-13535116.creator: Kelvin M Musa, Auson Albert, Jane G Zakaria, Ronald G Mbwasi, Anorld David, Elton Meleki
pmc-13535116.description: An 8‐year‐old boy sustained over 200 bee stings, developing airway‐threatening facial oedema requiring intubation and ICU admission, with severe anemia (Hb 3.2 g/dL), rhabdomyolysis, intravascular haemolysis and marked hepatic injury (AST 2505 U/L), yet preserved renal function. He recovered without dialysis, extubated by Day 3 and discharged by Day 8.

pmc-13552601.title: High‐Flow Nasal Cannula and Continuous Positive Airway Pressure in Infants With Acute Bronchiolitis—Trends of Use in Norway
pmc-13552601.creator: Knut Øymar, Joel Selvakumar, Maren Våland Øymar, Ingvild Dalen, Ken Erik Klaseie, Ujinthini Sivanantham, Kasper Øvsthus, Inger Heimdal, Kari Holte, Kari Risnes, Ketil Størdal, Claus Klingenberg
pmc-13552601.description: AimHigh‐flow nasal cannula (HFNC) and continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) are options for respiratory support in infants with bronchiolitis. The aim of this study was to evaluate the use of HFNC and CPAP in infants with bronchiolitis at five hospitals in Norway to study time trends over seasons and differences in use between hospitals.

pmc-13642087.title: Transmissive Terahertz Tunable and Multifunctional Polarization Manipulation With Ge/VO2 Hybrid Metasurface
pmc-13642087.creator: Xingxing Fan, Qiang Bian, Qingguo Du, Song Sun, Qin Fu, Zhengying Li, Fei Xu
pmc-13642087.description: To meet the growing demand for transmissive tunable multifunctional polarization manipulation devices, a tunable multifunctional polarization‐manipulating metasurface (TMPMM) based on germanium dielectric pillars and VO2 grating is proposed. When the VO2 grating is in the insulating state, efficient cross‐polarization conversion in the frequency range of 3.88–5.5 THz is achieved, with a maximum conversion efficiency exceeding 0.98.

pmc-13668047.title: Epigenetic Clocks Can Predict Age in the Largemouth Bass‐Complex Despite Spatial and Sexual Variation
pmc-13668047.creator: Steven T Gardner, Daniel J Daugherty, Dijar Lutz‐Carrillo, Brenda Pracheil, Kristine N Moody
pmc-13668047.description: Sustainable fisheries rely on balancing harvests with ecological impacts. Despite the importance of species' demographic profiles, many assessments forgo age due to methodological complexities. Developing non‐lethal methods for age determination can improve stock assessments to ensure future sustainability. Epigenetic signals, specifically DNA methylation, are dynamic and considered to be associated with decreasing genomic stability with age.

uslaw-usc-t10-s9442a.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9442a — Cadets: nomination in event of death, resignation, or expulsion from office of Member of Congress otherwise authorized to nominate
uslaw-usc-t10-s9442a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9442a.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part III (Training); Chapter 953 (United States Air Force Academy). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Senators.— In the event a Senator does not submit all nominations for cadets allocated to such Senator for an academic year in accordance with section 9442(a)(3) of this title, due to death, resignation from office, or expulsion from office.
